listing.name: Price of Command 0.0.10
listing.summary: Allows your officers to get tired, get injured, and, in the worst case, die.
listing.aiSummary: Adds officer fatigue, injury, and death mechanics while making officers cheaper and more numerous.

description: Officers can now become tired, injured, or die during combat. To balance this, hiring costs are reduced and the maximum roster size is increased. The mod provides APIs for other authors to implement custom conditions.

changelog.0.0.10: Mod now functions again after being completely broken by reflection shenanigans
changelog.0.0.9: Now compatible (hopefully) with all RCs of 0.97
changelog.0.0.8: Injuries avoided by a successful roll on the crew survival stat would be lost and not resolve correctly, resulting in a permanent bugged Injury skill and a permanently missing actual skill - I recommend installing Console Commands and giving your officers a free skill if you believe you've been impacted - The table detailing officer conditions in the After Action Report will no longer extend out of frame when officers have longer names
